_about: Step 2h readings (dekakuribo, togezo, patapata, pooka), in hand_read.json's entry structure, to be merged into reference/smashrun_enemy_specs/hand_read.json. Read from the 3DS enemy_fs.cro (update) ARM and code.bin (framework), addresses are enemy_fs.cro offsets unless marked code.bin / Wii U. W = the enemy work struct [[[acc+0x30B0]+8]+0]+4 (Wii U [[[acc+0x3130]+8]+0]+4): +0 HP (float), +4 max HP, +0x08..+0x44 the movement parameters the specs call 'KineticEnergy', +0x14 of [[acc+0x30B0]+8]+0 the flags word (bit 2 dead, bit 8 'landed/bullet done', 0x20 start flag, 0x80 stun). Node N = model.jtb entry N-1 (node 0 = bone 0). ACMD Special_Hitbox bone = node (same converter). random_range(int a, int b) is inclusive. See docs/smash-run-enemies/step2h-readings.md.

dekakuribo.summary: Big Goomba (Mario). Walks (WalkL 0.3x), every 60 frames searches a 150 x 40 box ahead; a fighter within 28 units: 3 frames standing (state 4) then the angry stomp dance (AngryL, 200 frames, foot hitboxes 4% + QUAKE each step); farther: a hop back (AttackRunStart) and a 200-frame charge (RunL 0.6x, head hitbox 6%, run turn when the target is behind). Walls / ledges (variation 1) turn it at the end of the walk loop. Stepped on: 25 HP off; survives -> Stepped (24 frames) and walks on, else Collapses (killed). It does NOT split (no articles, no create_enemy / spawn calls).
dekakuribo.variations: 0: walks off ledges; 1: turns at ledges (check_cliff in 3 / 7 / 8 / 9 sets the turn flag or stops). P0 has one row (all variations read row 0... the reader indexes P0 by kind only: f0 = 0).
dekakuribo.read: create 0x86D84, ctor 0x86FA4 (size 0x188; hashsets; damage labels DamageStart..DownWait, Fall), vtable 0xD02C0, state table 0x10F374; start 0x85A84, initialize 0x8630C, states 1 0x85DDC/0x864A0, 2 0x85E30/0x864E0, 3 0x85F3C/0x8675C, 4 0x86240/0x86B6C, 5 0x858FC/0x860A0, 6 0x86DBC/0x85BDC, 7 0x85EA4/0x8651C, 8 0x85954/0x860F0, 9 0x86F2C/0x85CCC, 10 0x86C14/0x86CC0, 11 0x859BC/0x861A0, 12 0x85BAC/0x86208, 13 0xB4088 (remove); slot 3 0x869F8, 21 0x85FE0, 45 0x869F4 (empty), 47 0x86C88, 48 0x86C80 (14), 54 0x861FC, 55 0x869E4, 74 / 75 0x85D9C / 0x86D44; 64-67 = 3 / 1 / 1 / 12.

states.1: Fall: Fall loop, kinetic 8, attach off; is_touch(8) -> interrupt 2.
states.2: Landing: Landing (once), kinetic 0, attach on, play_se 0x2910009, request_quake(3); motion end -> 3.
states.3: Walk (0x85F3C / 0x8675C): +0x180 (turn flag) = 0, WalkL loop, MotionModule +0x50 = P0 f4 0.3, kinetic 10, attach on. Update: every P1[0].interval (60) frames of the state counter (+0x170 + 1, slot 55 increments it) check_target(P1[0]: type 2, range 150 x 40, offset (10, 10), 0) -> +0x17C; found: reverse_lr(1, 1) if (fighter x - x) * stick x < 0, then 3D distance <= P0 f18 (28) -> 4, else -> 6. Ground: off -> 1; turn flag set: clear_speed_all until MotionModule is_looped, then reverse_lr(1, 1) and interrupt 3 (no turn motion); flag clear: variation 1 and check_cliff -> flag; is_touch(stick x > 0 ? 4 : 2) (wall ahead) -> flag.
states.4: Close target (0x86240 / 0x86B6C): W+0x24 = P0 f16 (0), W+0x2C = P0 f17 (0), kinetic 5 (a jump with zero kick: it stands), attach off, Fall loop, +0x184 = 1. Update: speed y <= 0 and on the ground: +0x184 < 3 -> change_kinetic(5), +1; else -> 5. Net: ~3 frames in the Fall pose, then 5.
states.5: Angry (0x858FC / 0x860A0): kinetic 0, attach on, AngryL loop (100 frames); state frame > P0 f19 (200) -> 3. Hitboxes from AngryL's ACMD (see danger).
states.6: Run start (0x86DBC / 0x85BDC): W+0x24 = P0 f7 (3), W+0x2C = P0 f8 (3.5); check_cliff_distance_lr(P0 f6 x (P0 f7 / gl+0x120 (gravity) + 2) x -2, -lr) (= 3/g + 2 behind it): a ledge behind -> W+0x20 = 0, else P0 f6 (-0.5) (hops backwards); kinetic 5, attach off, AttackRunStart at P0 f11 (0.6), +0x181 = 1. Update: speed y <= 0 and on the ground with +0x181: +0x181 = 0, attach on; state frame > P0 f10 (30) and +0x181 != 1 -> 7 with +0x178 = 0.
states.7: Run (0x85EA4 / 0x8651C): RunL loop, MotionModule +0x50 = P0 f9 (0.6), kinetic 10, attach on. Update: every P1[1].interval (100) of +0x178 (first at 0) check_target(P1[1]: 200 x 100, offset (0, 10)); the target behind (lr < 0 and dx > 0, or lr > 0 and dx < 0) -> 9. On the ground: check_cliff and variation 1 -> clear_speed_all, -> 9; wall ahead -> 9; off the ground -> 1; +0x178 > P0 f13 (200) -> 8; +0x178 += 1 (not reset by the turn: the charge lasts 200 frames in all).
states.8: Brake: RunBrakeL (once), kinetic 2, attach on, play_se 0x2910008. Update: variation != 1: off the ground -> 1; variation 1: check_cliff -> clear_speed_all; end -> 3.
states.9: Run turn: RunTurnL at P0 f12 (0.6), kinetic 2, attach on. Update: check_cliff -> clear_speed_all; end -> reverse_lr(1, 1), interrupt 7 if +0x168 == 7 (came from the run; slot 74 / 75 store the old state in +0x168 when old == 7 or new == 3), else interrupt 3.
states.10: Stepped (slot 21, HP left): kinetic 0, Stepped (24 frames), attach on, play_se 0x291000C; end -> 3.
states.11: Collapses (slot 21, HP 0): kinetic 0, Collapses (34 frames), attach on, BehaviorImpl::notify_on_death (death flag, delete_hit, attacks cleared, disable_hit), play_se 0x291000B; end -> create_dead_item(1, 20, 0, 0), -> 13.
states.12: Dead (slot 67): motion 18 (Damage) at rate 0, bullet(); W flags & 8 -> 13. Its hitbox is motion 18's ACMD (12%), not P2.

dekakuribo.stomp: Slot 21 (0x85FE0): DamageModule add_damage(P0 f15 = 25, 0), then HP (W+0) - 25: > 0 -> HP stored, interrupt 10 (Stepped); <= 0 -> HP = 0, interrupt 11 (Collapses). No state guard in slot 21 itself (BehaviorImpl::notify_on_death's disable_hit / the tread area keep it from repeating, inferred). Tread area (vl last group P5[0]) = {on 1, node 0 (bone 0), 14 x 3, offset (0, 6)}; area 1 {1, 0, 8, 12, 0, 4}. The fighter's bounce: no per-kind value in the behaviour; the tread event returns the enemy's param 0x11 (see patapata 'stomp_bounce').

danger.source: ACMD AngryL attack.bin (Set_Loop(100); WAIT 28: id 1 on 8 frames; WAIT 42: id 2 ...)
danger.note: id 1 node 6 = RFootJ frames 28-36 of each 100-frame loop, id 2 node 5 = LFootJ from frame 78 (the second stomp); angle -30 (330: down and forward), fixed 80, hitlag 2, SDI 1, trip 1.0, shield damage 2, rehit 60; QUAKE(3) and External_Graphic 0x1000026 at each stomp (frames 36 / 86)
node 4 = HeadN, whole run; hitlag 2, shield damage 2, rehit 60, facing restriction 3; RunL effect: 0x1000026 at (0, -10, 0) then Graphic_Effect2 0x1000019 x2 every 10 frames, QUAKE(3) every 10 frames
a push box: 0 damage, flinchless, no hitlag, no GFX (HeadN)

danger.source: ACMD motion 18 (Damage) attack.bin, played by the death state

dekakuribo.contact: No P2 contact: set_attack_data (slot 45) is an empty function (0x869F4) and the only P2 entry (state 0: power 6, angle 70, kbg 100, size 10, node 2 RotN, (2, 8, 0)) is never armed. Slot 47 (0x86C88) returns 0 in states 0 / 10 / 11 / 12 / 13, 1 otherwise; slot 48 returns 14 (no P2 entry has state 14: nothing armed). All its hitboxes are ACMD (above).
dekakuribo.targeting: start: faces get_nearest_target (check_turn_to_target + reverse_lr). Walk: P1[0] every 60 state frames, faces the found fighter; run: P1[1] every 100 run frames -> run turn if behind. No turn motion in the walk (reverse at the loop end).
dekakuribo.kinetics: initialize 0x8630C: W+0x08 = P0 f1 2, +0x0C = f2 1, +0x10 = 0, +0x14 = f5 0.01, +0x18 = f3 10, +0x24 = f7 3, +0x40 = 1, +0x44 = f14 0.9, +0x28 = f6 -0.5, +0x2C = f8 3.5, W-module vt+0x7C(0x20000004) (Wii U vt+0xFC). Walk / run: kinetic 10 (Kuribo's walk/run), rates 0.3 / 0.6 on MotionModule +0x50.
dekakuribo.death: Damage: slots 64 / 65 / 66 = 3 / 1 / 1; death 67 = 12 (bullet + ACMD 12% body). HP from its gl entry (not in the 3DS dump).
dekakuribo.effects_sounds: play_se 0x2910009 landing, 0x2910008 brake, 0x291000C stepped, 0x291000B collapse; request_quake(3) on landing; ACMD: RunL / AngryL QUAKE(3) + effects 0x1000026 / 0x1000019 (common bank), sounds 0x2910000-0x2910009 (sound.bin). Slot 3 (0x869F8, every frame): the eyes follow fighter 0: angle of (fighter 0 - node 2 RotN position) -> MotionModule set_frame_material(clamp(angle / 2pi x 60, 1, 59), 0), set_rate_material(0, 0).
dekakuribo.framework_new: add_damage (code.bin 0x4D2FE4; Wii U DamageModule acc+0x30D4: not mapped; the HP write W+0 is what the states use), MotionModuleImpl::is_looped (0x5048D0), EnemyKineticModuleImpl::get_sum_speed3f (0x96EBFC), check_cliff_distance_lr (0x9EAED4; the walker cave's CHECK_CLIFF_LR 0x026A6D88 takes the lr in f1: whether it also takes the distance is to check), set_frame_material / set_rate_material (0x7FB7FC / 0x5015AC; eyes only, optional), slot 3 hook (per-frame before the state update).
dekakuribo.open: Its HP (gl entry) on the Wii U; the exact meaning of slot 47 / 48; the tread area's (0, 6) offset field order (read as {on, node, w, h, x, y} as for Kuribo / Tiki Buzz).

togezo.summary: Spiny (Mario). Variation 1 walks (Walk, kinetic 1), turns at walls, turns toward fighters behind it (search every 20 frames) during its first 150 walk frames, and leaves after 200 walk frames. Variation 0 is the Spiny egg (Paipo): falls spinning, bounces, and when its bounce speed drops under 0.5 it hatches (Change) into variation 1. Its body hurts all the time (P2 entry 0 / 1, power 1). It cannot be stomped: its tread area is off (vl P5[0].on = 0), slot 21 is BehaviorImpl's nop, no enable_tread.
togezo.variations: 0: egg (Paipo mesh, rolls, hatches -> var 1 in place: L622F4 sets this+0x10 = 1); 1: walking Spiny (togezo mesh). P0 per variation: 0 {0, 0, 0, 0, 0.8, 2}, 1 {1, 0.3, 0.01, 1.75, 1, 0}.
togezo.read: create 0x37F14, ctor 0x37F4C (size 0x17C, no damage labels), vtable 0xCD7F0, table 0x1119CC; start 0x36CE0, initialize 0x370C0, set_attack_data 0x37568, slot 5 0x3736C, 13 0x376DC, 55 0x3740C, 60 0x376A4, 63 0xB4940, 66 0xB4964, 67 0xB492C, 69 0x37EAC; helpers L622F4 (hatch), L6239C (spin rate), L62440 (body attack); states 1 0x36FEC/0x37288, 2 0x37090/0x372C8, 3 0x36FA0/0x37260, 4 0x370A4/0x3766C, 5 0x37A0C/0x37E20, 6 0x377E8/0x37B48, 7 0x37880/0x37B88, 8 0x37984/0x37C7C, 9 0x3792C/0x37C28, 10 0x378D8/0x37BF8, 11 0x37760/0x37AB8, 12 0x379DC/0x37DE8, 13 remove.

states.1: Egg fall: kinetic 8, attach off, Paipo loop, +0x178 = L6239C (spin step), W+0x40 = P0[var] f4 (0.8 / 1); on the ground -> interrupt 2.
states.2: Egg bounce: kinetic 4 (bounce). Update: speed y <= 0 on the ground: |speed| < PS9c f0 (0.5) -> L622F4 (hatch) and -> 5; else +0x178 = L6239C (re-spin).
states.3: Egg stun (slot 69, var 0): kinetic 16, attach off, +0x16C = hit_return_frame(), +0x178 = L6239C; counts down -> 1.
states.4: Egg dead (slot 67 var 0): bullet(), +0x178 = 0; W flags & 8 -> 13. Armed: P2 entry 2.
states.5: Hatch (Change): kinetic 5, attach off, Change (30 frames), W+0x40 = P0[var] f4, play_se 0x6D90000; at the end on the ground: nearest target behind -> 9 (turn) else -> 8.
states.6: Fall (var 1): kinetic 8, attach off, Fall loop, W+0x40 = P0 f4; ground -> interrupt 7.
states.7: Landing: kinetic 0, attach on, Landing; end: target behind -> 9, else 8.
states.8: Walk (0x37984 / 0x37C7C): kinetic 1, attach on, Walk loop. Update: move(); off the ground -> 6; check_wall -> 9; walk timer +0x170 (start: PS8c f2 = 200) - 1 <= 0 -> 10 (leave); else search timer +0x174 (PS8c f3 = 150) - 1: while > 0, every search_interval(0) (20) frames search_target(0) (P1[0]: 100 x 60, offset (0, 10)) + check_turn_to_target -> 9. After 150 frames it no longer turns to targets.
states.9: Turn: kinetic 0, attach on, Turn; end -> reverse_lr(1, 1), interrupt 8.
states.10: Leave: Fall at rate 0, init_common_leave(P6 {120, 0.1, 5, 0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0.85}); update_common_leave() == 0 -> 13.
states.11: Stun (slot 69, var 1): kinetic 16, attach off, Damage loop, +0x16C = hit_return_frame(), W flags |= 0x80; count down: on the ground -> flags &= ~0x80, -> 8; in the air -> 6.
states.12: Dead (slot 67 var 1): Damage at rate 0, bullet(); flags & 8 -> 13. Armed: P2 entry 3.

danger.states: all (armed by start and the hatch, kept: set_attack_data clears only ids >= 1)
danger.note: var 0 (egg) entry 0 angle 361; var 1 entry 1 angle 70; node 2 = RotN; shield damage 1, rehit 60, facing 1 (fields after bkb as P2)

danger.source: set_attack_data 0x37568: entries 2.. whose state = the new state, id 0 (replaces the body box)

togezo.contact: yes, always (id 0, power 1, size 2 at RotN): the spikes. set_attack_data (0x37568) clears ids 1 .. count-1 only (AttackModule +0x3C = count), then arms P2 entries 2.. by state.
togezo.stomp: Cannot be stomped: tread area off (P5[0] = {0, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0}; area 1 {1, 2, 4, 4, 0, 0}), slot 21 not overridden (BehaviorImpl's nop), no enable_tread anywhere. A fighter landing on it just touches the always-on spike box.
togezo.targeting: start: no turn to a target (stick x = posture lr). Hatch / landing: faces the nearest target (turn motion). Walk: search group 0 every 20 frames for the first 150 walk frames, turn if behind.
togezo.kinetics: initialize 0x370C0 (per variation): W+0x10 / +0x08 = P0 f1 (0 / 0.3), +0x20 / +0x28 = f2 (0 / 0.01), +0x24 / +0x2C = f3 (0 / 1.75), +0x0C = f5 (2 / 0), +0x38 = PS8c f0 0.4. Spin (slot 55 0x3740C, var != 1): node 2 rotated about x by +0x178 per frame (MotionModule set_node_rotate(2), the posture rot): +0x178 = sign(-speed x) x |speed| x (EnemyParamAccessor+0x198 +0x90 x +0xA0) x -lr x pi/180 (L6239C). Slot 5 (update_on_skip) does the same rotate. start var 0 also copies node 2's rotation into the posture.
togezo.death: slots 64 / 65 = 0 (no damage states), 66 = var 1 ? 6 : 1, 67 = var 1 ? 12 : 4; slot 69 (0x37EAC): a running leave -> finalize_common_leave + set_correct(5); var 0 -> interrupt 3, var 1 -> interrupt 11; returns 1 (the framework's damage reaction is skipped: no damage motions, it has no damage labels). Slot 60 (0x376A4, var 0): hatch (L622F4) + interrupt 5 (caller not identified). Slot 63 returns 0 in states 10 / 11 / 12. Slot 13 (capture motion) only for var 1.
togezo.leave: after 200 walk frames (+0x170 counts only in the walk): state 10, init_common_leave(P6: 120 frames, 0.1, 5, effect 0x8000005 at (0, 3, 0) x 0.85 as Waddle Doo's), then remove. A hit during the leave cancels it (slot 69).
togezo.effects_sounds: play_se 0x6D90000 (hatch); the common leave effect; no ACMD (no attack / effect scripts).
togezo.meshes: 0 togezo_mh, 1 togezo_paipo_mh: var 0 starts paipo on / togezo off, the hatch (L622F4) and var 1 togezo on / paipo off.
togezo.framework_new: AttackModuleImpl::clear(id, bool) (code.bin 0x4CE5AC; Wii U not mapped: the cave can keep clear_all + re-arm id 0), init / update / finalize_common_leave (the cave has them), hit_return_frame (the cave's f_hitret), MotionModuleImpl::node_rotate / set_node_rotate (Wii U SET_NODE_ROT 0x02C64188) and PostureModule rot (the egg's spin: visual), slot 5 update_on_skip, slot 60 (caller unknown).
togezo.open: Who calls slot 60 (inferred: something that forces the egg to hatch); EnemyParamAccessor+0x198's +0x90 / +0xA0 (a common param, the spin factor); P0 f0 / PS8c f1 / PS9c f1 (read nowhere in these functions); kinetic 4 (bounce) parameters (W+0x40 = 0.8 restitution, inferred).

patapata.summary: Koopa Paratroopa / Koopa Troopa (Mario). Variations 0 / 1 are winged: hop forward (kinetic 5 hops) and dive-bite a fighter found below-ahead (Bite, HeadN hitbox 4%, angle -50); stomped or hit (not killed), they lose the wings (variation += 2, effect 0x7030000) and become walking Koopas. Variations 2 / 3 walk (kinetic 1), and leap at a fighter ahead (JumpHold -> JumpAttack, HeadN 2%). Stomped as a Koopa: ShellMode (hit off, tread off), it is defeated and its shell becomes an item (item kind 0x94 'patapata', thrown with its speed); killed as a Koopa: a spinning shell hitbox 17% (state 20) then the same shell item. Killed winged: bullet with a 2% body.
patapata.variations: 0 / 2: material frame 10, the shell item's variation 1; 1 / 3: material frame 0, the shell item's variation 0 (colour per frame not checked: red / green). 1 (winged): on each landing 60 % (random_range(1, 100) <= P@0x78 60, inclusive) searches group 2 (80 x 80, offset (-40, 20)) and turns (TurnPatapata) if the fighter is behind. 3 (walking): turns at ledges (check_cliff). 0 / 2: no ledge check. P0 rows: 0 / 1 {.., 0.6, 2.5, 1, 1, 2.5, 0.7, 15, 9, 0.5}, 2 {.., 0.2, 0.5, .., 0.7, 1, 20, 0}, 3 {.., 0.2, 0.3, ..}.

states.1: Winged fall: L5DAB4, kinetic 8, attach off, Fly loop; ground -> 2.
states.2: Hop (0x725E8 / 0x72860): L5D7EC (W+0x08 / +0x20 / +0x28 = P0 f3 0.6, +0x0C / +0x24 / +0x2C = f4 2.5, +0x40 = f5 1), kinetic 5 (the hop), attach off, Fly loop, stick x = lr, +0x1F0 = 0. Update: first falling frame -> L73E48 (W+0x40 = f6 1; energy 0 +0x38 = f3 0.6, +0x3C = f7 2.5). Landing (speed y <= 0, ground): var 1: 60 % search_target(2) + target behind -> 3, else -> 2 (hop again). check_wall -> 3. Search: when +0x1DC <= 0 and the bite cool-down +0x1E8 <= 0: +0x1DC = search_interval(var) (10), search_target(var) (group 0 / 1: 42.5 x 50, offset (5, 5)): found -> reverse_lr if behind, -> 5. +0x1DC / +0x1E8 -1, move().
states.3: Turn (ground): L5D7EC, kinetic 0, attach on, TurnPatapata; end -> reverse_lr(1, 1), interrupt 1.
states.4: Turn (air): L5DAB4, kinetic -1, attach off, TurnPatapata; same update (unused by the code read: no transition to 4 found).
states.5: Bite wind-up: aerial set_mode_normal(0, 0, 0, 0, 10, 10), aerial set_current_speed((0, -P0 f11 0.5)), attach off, Bite at P@0x80 (PS78 f2) 1.5, +0x1E0 = P0 f9 (15 / 1); aerial update; count -> 6.
states.6: Bite (P2 entry 0 armed): +0x1E0 = P0 f10 (9 / 20); aerial update; count -> 7; motion end -> 1 with the cool-down +0x1E8 = PS78 f1 30.
states.7: Bite recovery (no hitbox): aerial update; end -> 1, +0x1E8 = 30.
states.8: Dead winged (slot 67 var 0 / 1): BulletMode at rate 0, bullet() (P2 entry 3); flags & 8 -> 23.
states.9: Wing loss (slot 21 / slot 69 / slot 13 for var 0 / 1): L5DAB4, kinetic 8, clear_speed_all, attach off, NokonokoMode, var += 2, wing mesh off, EffectModule req(0x7030000, position, ZERO, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0) (one-shot at the posture), L5D968 (walk params); end -> 10.
states.10: Fall (walking): kinetic 8, attach off, Fall; ground -> interrupt 11.
states.11: Landing: kinetic 0, attach on, Landing; end -> 12.
states.12: Walk (0x732A4 / 0x73898): kinetic 1, attach on, Walk loop. Update: search when +0x1DC <= 0 and +0x1E8 <= 0: +0x1DC = search_interval(var) (30), search_target(var + 1) (group 3 / 4: 70 x 30, offset (10, 10)): found -> reverse_lr if behind, -> 14. Ground: check_wall (or var 3 and check_cliff) -> 13; else move(); off the ground -> 10.
states.13: Turn: kinetic 0, attach on, TurnNokonoko; end -> reverse_lr, interrupt 12.
states.14: Jump hold: kinetic 0, attach on, JumpHold at PS84 f0 (1); end -> 15.
states.15: Jump attack: set_kinetic_shoot(PS84 f2 3, f3 1, f4 0.075) (W+0x20 = 3, +0x24 = 1, +0x28 = -1, +0x2C = 10, +0x1C = 0.075, vt+0x7C(0x20000004), kinetic 5), attach off, JumpAttack at PS84 f1 (3), +0x1E0 = P0 f9 (1), +0x1DC = PS84 f10 (15); move(); count -> 16.

states.17: Slide: set_kinetic_brake_ground(PS84 f5 0.04) (W+0x14, kinetic 2), attach on; on the ground: +0x1E0 -1 (clear_all at 0), +0x1DC -1 < 0 -> +0x1E8 = 20, interrupt 18; off -> 10.
states.18: Landing attack: set_kinetic_brake_ground(PS84 f7 0.1), attach on, LandingJumpAttack at PS84 f6 (1.5); move(); end -> 12.
states.19: Shell (slot 21 var 2 / 3: stomped as a Koopa): kinetic 0, attach on, ShellMode, disable_hit, disable_tread, set_current_damage(0); first time (+0x1FC): create_dead_item(1, 0, 0, 0), EnemyManager::set_already_dead_flag(id), +0x1FC = 0. Update (0x73A24): motion end on the ground: create_item_and_throw(0x94, var 0 / 2 ? 1 : 0, position + (0, P@0xB0 (3) - speed y, 0), current speed, 0.0, true, -1, -1) -> +0x1F4; an item made -> set_visibility(0); -> 23 (removed).

states.22: ShellReturn: passable off, attach on, ShellReturn; end: enable_hit, enable_tread, ground -> 12 / air -> 10. (Reached only from 21.)

patapata.stomp: Slot 21 (0x726BC): var 0 / 1 -> interrupt 9 (wing loss: becomes var 2 / 3, walks on, alive); var 2 / 3 -> interrupt 19 (shell: defeated, the shell item 0x94 thrown). Tread area P5[0] = {1, 0 (bone 0), 4 x 8, offset (0, 8)}; area 1 {1, 0, 8, 12, 0, 8}.
patapata.stomp_bounce: The 3DS Paratroopa code sets no bounce: slot 21 only changes state. The fighter's bounce comes from the tread link event: the fighter's tread status (MSC) sends LinkEvent kind 6 through LinkModule (3DS LinkModuleImpl::notify_event_msc_cmd 0x4794E0, event built at code.bin 0x479834-0x479868; Wii U LinkModule MSC handler 0x02C58578, op 3 at 0x02C588C4, event 6 built at 0x02C58AE8-0x02C58B6C, sent by LinkModule vt+0x8C) with +0x20 float = 1.0 (Wii U default 0x1010980C), +0x2C/+0x2D/+0x2E bytes 0, and copies the answer back to script variables (+0x20 float, +0x24 / +0x28 floats, +0x2C..+0x2E bytes, +0x1C int; returns byte +0x18). An enemy answers in its event handler (3DS code.bin 0x757A14: module [enemy+0xDC] vt+0x20(0x11); Wii U 0x02D8C450 case 6 at 0x02D8C5D4: behaviour slot 20 (0x02DB98F4), then acc+0x315C vt+0x44(0x11) -> event +0x20, +0x2E = 1): a per-kind jump multiplier from the enemy param (id 0x11, gl entry; value per kind not read). GREEN SHELL (user's reference for Koopa-type enemies): item kind 0x46 'greenshell' (Wii U item table 0x104157A0, 0x24-byte entries, name at +0x18; 3DS 0xC2EB28 the same). A scan of the whole Wii U text (and the 3DS code.bin) finds no other writer of the tread event's +0x20 / +0x2E than the enemy handler (Wii U 0x02D8C5F8 / 0x02D8C600; 3DS 0x757A34 / 0x757A38); the only item link-event switch found (Wii U 0x0303CC40, kinds 2 / 8) has no case 6. So a fighter treading a Green Shell gets the event's default multiplier 1.0, i.e. its own footstool jump: fighter_param 0x15F step_jump_speed_y (0x160 step_mini_jump_speed_y for the short one) x 1.0, in its StepJump status (0xB3). USE FOR PARATROOPA / KOOPA: StatusModule(3, 0xB3 StepJump, 0) with multiplier 1.0 (what fix v8's stomp already does: no extra speed write). Not verified: that the fighter's tread MSC multiplies step_jump_speed_y by the event float (inferred from the 1.0 default), and the green shell's own tread path (its tread area and whether treading it goes through event 6 at all) was not traced; the Wii U fighter MSC tread status was not read.

patapata.death: Non-lethal hit: slot 69 (0x73C00) var 0 / 1 -> the wing loss (var += 2, mesh, effect 0x7030000, walk params; no state change), returns 0 (the framework's damage reaction runs) -> slots 64 / 65 / 66 = var 0 / 1 ? 2 / 1 / 1 : 12 / 10 / 10 (read after the var change: a winged one comes back walking). Lethal (BehaviorImpl::notify_on_damage calls slot 67 before slot 69): 67 = var 0 / 1 ? 8 : 20. Slot 71 (0x72A88): var 0 / 1 BehaviorImpl::notify_on_death; var 2 / 3 instead push a request into the module at acc+0x30A0 (inlined queue, not mapped; no notify_on_death: the shell states disable hit / tread themselves); +0x1FC = 0 (so a killed Koopa makes no create_dead_item in 20). Slot 13 (capture motion) also de-wings. Slot 28 notify_on_remove: Behavior::notify_on_remove.

patapata.open: State 21 / 22 are not entered by any code read (an item / link path?); is_generate_shoot's true branch at start (spawned by a shooter: no first state set); the acc+0x30A0 request in slot 71; the material frame -> colour; whether the Wii U has item 0x94's code and files; the enemy param 0x11 value per kind (the bounce multiplier).

pooka.summary: Pooka (Dig Dug). Walks (Move, kinetic 1), turns at random(30, 90)-frame intervals toward the nearest fighter, searches every 15 frames (45 x 40, offset (25, 10)); found: backs off (Attackhold 1.5x, 40 frames) and lunges (jump, Attack, BodyN hitbox 2%) bouncing off the first thing it hits. A target it cannot reach (ground in the way) makes it go 'ghost' (goggle eyes only, no collision, no hit) and float through walls toward it. Damage below 85 % of its HP inflates it (Damageballoon: the balloon's frame follows the HP lost); left alone it deflates back (HP restored to 90 %); at 0 HP it inflates fully and pops after 15 frames: a size-30 burst (6%, angle 70, fixed 60) that hits fighters around it, then it is removed.
pooka.variations: one P0 row (variation 0); none differ in code.

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, attach off, passable off, reset_gravity (W+0x3C = gl+0x120, +0x40 = 1), Move at rate 0 (loop), normal meshes; ground -> 2.
states.2: Landing (Landiing): kinetic 0, attach on; end: target behind -> 4, else 3.
states.3: Walk (0x21678 / 0x22494): W+0x10 = P0 f1 0.04, +0x08 = f2 0.15, +0x14 = f3 0.01, kinetic 1, attach on, Move at P0 f6 (1) loop, turn timer +0x168 = random_range(f4 30, f5 90), +0x16C = f7 10, +0x170 = search_interval(0) (15). Update: move(); on the ground and no ledge: every f7 (10) frames (+0x16C): the nearest fighter within P0 f8 (200) of center_pos with GroundModule ray_check blocked -> 8 (ghost) or (a second ray / angle test) -> 9 (jump); +0x170 countdown: search_target(0) found -> 5; +0x168 countdown: face the nearest target (turn) and re-pick random(30, 90); check_wall -> 4; ledge -> 4; off the ground -> 1. (The 8 / 9 choice was taken from the generated map, not fully re-read.)
states.4: Turn: kinetic 0, attach on, Turn; end -> reverse_lr(1, 1), interrupt 3.
states.5: Back-off (Attackhold): W+0x10 = 0.1, +0x08 = P0 f13 0.4, +0x14 = 0, kinetic 1, attach on, Attackhold at f15 1.5, play_se 0x6B10006, +0x170 = f14 40. Update: move with the stick reversed (backs away), a ledge -> clear_speed_all + kinetic 0; count -> 6.
states.6: Lunge (P2 entry 0 armed): W+0x20 = f16 2, +0x24 = f17 1, +0x28 / +0x2C = 10, +0x1C = 0, +0x3C = gl+0x120, kinetic 5, attach off, Attack at f18 0.1 (loop), play_se 0x6B10007, +0x17C = -1. Update: slot 7 (attack hit, 0x23670) stores the hit object's id in +0x17C; a hit object (or check_wall) -> bounce: away from the object's center_pos (or the wall's get_ground_normal(6)), speed |v| x P0 f19 (0.5), kinetic 5, AttackModule clear_all (the hitbox ends at the first hit / wall), +0x17C = -1; speed y <= 0 on the ground -> interrupt 7.
states.7: Landing slide: kinetic 26 with energy 0's x speed kept (y 0), attach on, Landiing; |speed x| < 0.1 on the ground -> 3.
states.8: Ghost: kinetic 26, energy 0 zeroed (+0x38 / +0x3C = 10), attach off, set_correct(0) (no ground collision), disable_hit, Move, meshes off but the goggles (L65084(0, 0, 0)), request_follow_effect(0x7200000, node 1, ZERO, ZERO, 1) -> +0x174, +0x16C = 0. Update: every P0 f11 (30) frames: the nearest fighter within f12 (200): flies toward it (calc_angle, energy 0 speed (cos, sin) x the param speed, +0x1C = 1); once the ray checks clear: set_correct(5), enable_hit, normal meshes, visible, remove_effect(+0x174), -> 1, +0x178 = 1.
states.9: Jump over: kinetic 8, set_current_speed(computed), attach off, passable on, Move; 10 frames -> 1.
states.10: Balloon (slot 67 death state, slot 69 / 60 / 70 / 17): the launch: W+0x20 / +0x24 from the hit (P0 f30 50, f27 0.2, f28 0.45 and the damage), +0x28 / +0x2C = 10, +0x1C = f31 0.025, +0x3C = f32 0.015, kinetic 5, attach off, ray_check_from_pos (20 units) limits the rise, Damageballoon at frame +0x184 rate 0, damage meshes, +0x168 = P0 f24 (15), +0x170 = dead (W flags bit 2) ? P0 f33 (0) : f25 (100), +0x188 = 1 (inflating), +0x189 = 0. Update: move(); bounces on landing (vy x -0.8). Inflating: the frame follows (threshold - HP) x 100 / threshold (% of end_frame); +0x168 -1, then +0x170 -1: at 0: dead -> interrupt 11 (pop); else +0x188 = 0, +0x189 = 1 (deflating), +0x170 = f25 100. Deflating (+0x188 = 0): frame -= P0 f26 (0.3) a frame, set_current_damage so HP climbs with it, update_weaken; frame 0 -> HP set to P0 f29 (90) % of max, reset_gravity, -> 1.
states.11: Pop (P2 entry 1 armed): kinetic -1, attach off, (an inlined module request at acc+0x30AC: status 0x2711, not mapped), meshes (1, 1, 0), EffectModule req(0x7200001, node 3 (HipN), ZERO, ZERO, P0 f35 3, ...) (one-shot burst x3), play_se 0x6B10005, +0x170 = f34 1. Update: move(); count 0 -> create_dead_item(1, 0, 0, 0), request_quake(3); the sound 0x6B10005 no longer playing -> 12.

pooka.contact: only the lunge (6) and the pop (11). No bullet() death (death state 10 = the balloon). No ACMD attack scripts (Attack's init effect script: Graphic_Effect2 0x1000009).
pooka.stomp: Cannot be stomped: tread area off (P5[0] = {0, 0, 12, 12, 0, 0}; area 1 {1, 0, 15, 15, 0, 6}); slot 21 not overridden; no enable_tread.
pooka.targeting: start: faces the nearest target; threshold +0x180 = P0 f23 (85) % of max HP; a reachable-but-blocked target at start -> 8 (ghost), else 1. Walk: search group 0 (interval 15, 45 x 40, offset (25, 10)); random(30, 90) turn checks toward the nearest.
pooka.kinetics: initialize 0x222BC: W+0x10 = P0 f1 0.04, +0x08 = f2 0.15, +0x14 = f3 0.01. See the states.
pooka.death: Inflate / pop: slot 11 (notify_on_damage 0x22900): HP <= threshold -> stop the link / hit stop (LinkModule to_link_stop / leave_link_stop, StopModule leave_stop_internal: inlined), play_se 0x6B10004, then BehaviorImpl::notify_on_damage. Slot 69 (0x23A48): damage meshes, passable off; HP <= threshold -> interrupt 10, returns 1 (no normal reaction); else returns 0 (normal damage reaction, back to 3 / 1 / 1). Lethal: death state 67 = 10 (dead flag set): inflates, pops after 15 frames (11). Slot 56 (0x2376C, per frame after the state?): keeps the balloon frame / deflation in the damage states (mirrors 10's update). Slot 60 (0x22A68): reset_gravity; HP >= threshold: HP back to at most 90 %, frame 0, normal meshes, update_weaken; else -> 10. Slot 70 (0x23B14): when the common state (+0xE4) is 0 and HP <= threshold -> 10; otherwise damage meshes, passable off, and HP <= threshold: Damageballoon at the kept frame (+0x188 = 1) (guards from the generated map). Slot 17 (capture cut) -> 10. Slot 13 (capture motion): the gl capture motion and the balloon flags.
pooka.effects_sounds: follow effect 0x7200000 node 1 (ghost; removed when it reappears); one-shot 0x7200001 node 3 x3 (pop); request_quake(3) at the pop; play_se 0x6B10004 (inflate hit), 0x6B10005 (pop), 0x6B10006 (back-off), 0x6B10007 (lunge).
pooka.meshes: 0 body_damage, 1 body_normal_L, 2 body_normal_R, 3 eye_damage, 4 eye_normal, 5 gogle, 6 leg: L65084(damage, ?, visible) and slot 51 (sync_lr_and_direction 0x65060) pick body_normal_L / _R by lr (posture lr == -1 -> L), normal / damage sets; the ghost shows only the goggles.
pooka.facing: slot 38 returns 1; slot 51 swaps the L / R body meshes with lr.
pooka.framework_new: set_current_damage (code.bin 0x7B3688; Wii U INIT_DAMAGE 0x02C212F0 + HP write), update_weaken (0x7B0FE8), reset_gravity (0x7B0F64: W+0x3C = gl+0x120, +0x40 = 1: inline), MotionModule set_frame (0x504928) / end_frame (0x953F98), calc_angle (0x7B01D8), ray_check (Wii U RAY_CHECK 0x02C39F18) / ray_check_from_pos (0x7B2E34), set_current_speed (0x7B24B4), get_current_speed_all (0x9EAD88), disable_hit / enable_hit (Wii U 0x026A75C0 / 0x026A75D4), set_correct (Wii U 0x02C36458), get_ground_normal (Wii U 0x02D64ABC), SoundModule is_playing (0x4C27BC: the pop's end; a fixed timer would do), slot 7 (attack hit) / 11 / 51 / 56 / 60 / 69 / 70 / 17 hooks, set_mesh_visibility (no Wii U path).
pooka.open: State 3's ghost / jump choice and state 8's flight speed (P0 f9 / f10 / f22?) were taken from the generated map, not fully re-read; slot 70 / 56 / 60 callers (slot numbers inferred); the inlined acc+0x30A4 / 0x30AC requests (link stop / status 0x2711); its HP (gl).
